Hakimi Hat-Trick Leads PSG to 5-1 Victory Against Le Havre in Ligue 1

31 Oct 2026, 01:42 PM IST · GlobeWire Daily Editorial Desk · Source: www.aljazeera.com

Paris Saint-Germain Extends Ligue 1 Lead

Paris Saint-Germain secured a 5-1 victory against Le Havre in a Ligue 1 fixture played on Friday, according to sports reports. Despite missing several regular players due to injury, the European champions rotated their squad and capitalized on a standout performance by fullback Achraf Hakimi to claim the win at Stade Oceane.

The result moves Paris Saint-Germain to 20 points from their opening nine league fixtures, placing them two points ahead of second-placed Lille and four points clear of Rennes.

Match Breakdown and Key Highlights

  • Early Lead: Le Havre opened the scoring when Josh Maja put the hosts ahead.
  • Hakimi's Response: Achraf Hakimi assisted Mika Godts for the equalizer before scoring himself in the 28th minute.
  • Second-Half Surge: Hakimi converted a free kick in the 55th minute, set up a counterattack finished by Senny Mayulu in the 62nd minute, and completed his hat-trick with a deflected effort in the 69th minute.
  • Final Score: PSG 5, Le Havre 1.

Reporting indicates that the victory marks Paris Saint-Germain's ninth consecutive win across all competitions. Meanwhile, Le Havre remains at the bottom of the league standings with two points, suffering their fifth consecutive defeat.

Manager and Standings Context

Following the match, PSG coach Luis Enrique noted the importance of squad depth. “I am happy because some players had very little playing time. If we want to win trophies, we need everyone,” he stated.

In other Ligue 1 action highlighted in the reports, Lille moved into second place after a late 86th-minute winner from Olivier Giroud secured a 1-0 derby victory against RC Lens. Rennes dropped to third following a 5-2 defeat to Nice, where Elye Wahi also scored a hat-trick.

Readers can verify official standings, match statistics, and subsequent league fixture announcements directly through the official Ligue 1 website or verified club channels.
